punchline: Five words in front of a thought change its job from fact to broadcast.
thirty_sec: Russ Harris says the thinking self is a radio playing Doom and Gloom all day. Defusion means treating thoughts as just words and pictures. You can put 'I'm having the thought that' in front, imagine a cartoon character saying it aloud, or say 'Thanks Mind, but I'm not playing today.' When a thought hooks you, you unhook and return to the breath.
